verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Galileo can 'set up prompt templates' via its MCP server (galileo-docs-4, galileo-docs-32), but there is no documentation of prompt versioning, rollback, or a mechanism to deploy prompt changes to production independent of code deployment. Missing for 10: prompt version history/rollback, a deployment/promotion workflow for prompts, and any evidence that prompt changes take effect in production without a code release.
